cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: GDP = C+I+G+(X-M); Real = nominal/deflatorx100; Deflator = nominal/realx100

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: AD: C (wealth, confidence, rates), I (confidence, rates, tech), G (policy), X-M (exchange rate, world income)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: SRAS: sticky wages/prices; LRAS: vertical at Yf (classical) or upward (Keynesian); AS shifts: costs, productivity

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: Inflation: demand-pull (AD>AS), cost-push (AS left); CPI basket vs RPI (housing); costs: menu, shoe-leather, uncertainty

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: Unemployment: frictional (search), structural (skills mismatch), cyclical (AD deficient), natural = frictional+structural

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: Fiscal: G↑/T↓ -> AD↑; Multiplier = 1/(1-MPC); Crowding out: G↑->r↑->I↓

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: Monetary: Bank Rate -> market rates -> AD; QE: buy bonds -> money supply↑; Inflation target 2%

cards.front: Recall a key point about Macroeconomics
cards.back: Exchange rate: floating (market), fixed (peg); Appreciation: X↓ M↑ -> AD↓; BOP: current + capital + financial account
